name: KuCoin KuCard
summary: A crypto-enabled Visa debit card for EEA residents that instantly converts digital assets to EUR at the point of sale with no decline fees.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the KuCoin KuCard charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the KuCoin KuCard?
faq.answer: It charges about 1% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the KuCoin KuCard require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
